import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== ANALYSIS AT DAY {day} ===")

print("\n1. LEDGER BY CATEGORY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) as total_amount
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

cash = nm.query("SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) as cash FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['cash']
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash:,.2f}")

print("\n2. AD CHANNEL EFFECTIVENESS (ALL TIME):")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) as spend,
           ROUND(SUM(leads_generated) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 2) as leads_per_1k
    FROM ad_channel_leads
    GROUP BY channel_id, group_id
    ORDER BY group_id, leads_per_1k DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(f"  {r['group_id']} | {r['channel_id']:18s} | leads={r['leads']:4d} | spend=${r['spend']:7.1f} | leads/$1k={r['leads_per_1k']}")

print("\n3. CUSTOMER CONVERSION BY GROUP & DAY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(AVG(s.seat_count), 1) as avg_seats
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n4. CONVERSION SUMMARY BY GROUP (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_price
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n5. ACTIVE SUBSCRIBERS & USAGE BY GROUP & PLAN:")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as active_subs,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(AVG(u.avg_daily_usage), 1) as avg_daily_usage
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, AVG(usage_units) as avg_daily_usage
        FROM daily_usage
        WHERE day > {day - 7}
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) u ON s.customer_id = u.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n6. ACQUISITION SOURCE OF NEW CUSTOMERS (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status
    ORDER BY c.group_id, cnt DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n7. ISSUES SUMMARY:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, status, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(AVG(days_open), 2) as avg_days_open
    FROM issues
    GROUP BY group_id, status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n8. AGENT SOCIAL POSTS & RECENT SOCIAL POSTS:")
res = nm.query("SELECT * FROM agent_social_media_posts ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 5")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Agent post:", r)
res = nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 15")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Customer post:", r)

print("\n9. OPEN ENTERPRISE TURNS:")
res = nm.query("SELECT * FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed = 0 ORDER BY day ASC")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Enterprise turn:", r)

arguments.content:
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Updating prices for high conversion & strong margins...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=12.0, B=45.0, C=99.0))

print("2. Upgrading model tiers (A=3, B=4, C=5) to boost delivered quality early...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=3, B=4, C=5))

print("3. Expanding usage quotas (A=600, B=2000, C=6000) to eliminate quota friction...")
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=600, B=2000, C=6000))

print("4. Updating daily spend (ops=750, dev=5000)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=750.0, development=5000.0))

print("5. Setting targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 150.0,
    'S2': 50.0,
    'S3': 50.0,
}))

print("6. Updating targeted dev spend...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 3000.0,
    'S2': 6000.0,
    'S3': 6000.0,
    'E1': 3000.0,
    'E2': 3000.0,
    'E3': 3000.0,
}))

print("7. Focusing targeted ad spend on highest-ROI channels...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 700.0, 'S2': 300.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 500.0, 'S3': 300.0},
}))

print("8. Updating lead promotions...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 2.0, 'S2': 8.0, 'S3': 8.0}
))

print("9. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="We heard you: today we increased daily usage quotas by 4x-8x across all plans, upgraded every plan to next-gen reasoning & frontier models, and expanded dedicated support!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== ANALYSIS AT DAY {day} ===")

print("\n1. LEDGER BY CATEGORY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) as total_amount
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

cash = nm.query("SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) as cash FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['cash']
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash:,.2f}")

print("\n2. AD CHANNEL EFFECTIVENESS (ALL TIME):")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) as leads, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) as spend,
           ROUND(SUM(leads_generated) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 2) as leads_per_1k
    FROM ad_channel_leads
    GROUP BY channel_id, group_id
    ORDER BY group_id, leads_per_1k DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(f"  {r['group_id']} | {r['channel_id']:18s} | leads={r['leads']:4d} | spend=${r['spend']:7.1f} | leads/$1k={r['leads_per_1k']}")

print("\n3. CUSTOMER CONVERSION BY GROUP & DAY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(AVG(s.seat_count), 1) as avg_seats
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, c.created_day, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n4. CONVERSION SUMMARY BY GROUP (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_price
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n5. ACTIVE SUBSCRIBERS & USAGE BY GROUP & PLAN:")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as active_subs,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(AVG(u.avg_daily_usage), 1) as avg_daily_usage
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT customer_id, AVG(usage_units) as avg_daily_usage
        FROM daily_usage
        WHERE day > {day - 7}
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) u ON s.customer_id = u.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n6. ACQUISITION SOURCE OF NEW CUSTOMERS (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status
    ORDER BY c.group_id, cnt DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n7. ISSUES SUMMARY:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, status, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(AVG(days_open), 2) as avg_days_open
    FROM issues
    GROUP BY group_id, status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n8. AGENT SOCIAL POSTS & RECENT SOCIAL POSTS:")
res = nm.query("SELECT * FROM agent_social_media_posts ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 5")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Agent post:", r)
res = nm.query(f"SELECT * FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 15")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Customer post:", r)

print("\n9. OPEN ENTERPRISE TURNS:")
res = nm.query("SELECT * FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed = 0 ORDER BY day ASC")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Enterprise turn:", r)

import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Upgrading capacity tier to Tier 3 (2,500,000 units/day) for sub-150ms weekday latency...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=3))

print("2. Updating prices (A=16, B=54, C=119)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=16.0, B=54.0, C=119.0))

print("3. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) so delivered quality strictly rises...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))

print("4. Keeping generous usage quotas (A=600, B=2000, C=6000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=600, B=2000, C=6000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($1 off for S1 leads -> $15 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 1.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Clearing ongoing promotions so all renewals and B/C signups pay full price...")
print(nm.pricing.set_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={},
    by_customer={},
    by_group_plan={}
))

print("7. Updating daily spend (ops=1000, dev=4000)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1000.0, development=4000.0))

print("8. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 250.0,
    'S2': 150.0,
    'S3': 150.0,
}))

print("9. Setting targeted dev spend ($11,500/day total)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 1000.0,
    'S2': 2500.0,
    'S3': 2500.0,
    'E1': 2000.0,
    'E2': 1500.0,
    'E3': 2000.0,
}))

print("10. Allocating $4,500/day targeted ad spend to highest-ROI channels...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1300.0, 'S2': 900.0, 'S3': 150.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 900.0, 'S2': 250.0, 'S3': 800.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("11. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Upgraded fleet capacity to 2.5M daily units for sub-150ms response times, published transparent rate-limit & SLA benchmarks, and launched guided workflow tutorials across all plans!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Replying to all 12 open enterprise threads (2 counter-offers + 10 new leads)...")
deals = [
    [8686, [["A", 7.0], ["B", 8.92], ["C", 11.5]]],
    [9780, [["A", 6.5], ["B", 8.0], ["C", 8.40]]],
]
for cid in [12984, 14058, 14061, 15048, 15051, 16899, 16900, 16902, 16903, 16904]:
    deals.append([cid, [["A", 7.5], ["B", 10.5], ["C", 13.5]]])
print(nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals))

print("2. Upgrading capacity tier to Tier 4 (8,000,000 units/day) as weekday usage passes 1.7M/day...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4))

print("3. Updating prices (A=18, B=58, C=129) ahead of Week 2 renewal wave...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=18.0, B=58.0, C=129.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) and quotas generous (600, 2000, 6000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=600, B=2000, C=6000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($1 off for S1 leads -> $17 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 1.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=1200, dev=3000)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1200.0, development=3000.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 350.0,
    'S2': 200.0,
    'S3': 150.0,
    'E1': 100.0,
}))

print("8. Focusing targeted dev spend on E1/E2/E3 ($9,500/day total)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 500.0,
    'S2': 1000.0,
    'S3': 1000.0,
    'E1': 2000.0,
    'E2': 2500.0,
    'E3': 2500.0,
}))

print("9. Scaling high-ROI targeted ad spend to $5,500/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1600.0, 'S2': 1200.0, 'S3': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 1000.0, 'S2': 300.0, 'S3': 1000.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Scaled GPU cluster to 8M daily units with <150ms P95 latency, expanded 1-day support coverage, and shipped new workflow templates for solo creators & enterprise teams!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== ANALYSIS AT DAY {day} ===")

print("\n1. LEDGER BY CATEGORY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) as total_amount
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

cash = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) as cash FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['cash']
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash:,.2f}")

print("\n2. SERVICE DAY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT day, total_usage_units, ROUND(p95_ms, 1) as p95_ms, ROUND(error_rate, 4) as err, downtime_minutes, capacity_tier, capacity_units
    FROM service_day
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    ORDER BY day
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n3. CONVERSION SUMMARY BY GROUP (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_price
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n4. ACTIVE SUBSCRIBERS BY GROUP & PLAN:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as active_subs,
           SUM(s.seat_count) as total_seats,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n5. ACQUISITION SOURCE OF NEW CUSTOMERS (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.status
    ORDER BY c.group_id, cnt DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n6. OPEN ISSUES BY OPEN_DAY & GROUP:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, open_day, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM issues
    WHERE status = 'open'
    GROUP BY group_id, open_day
    ORDER BY open_day, group_id
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n7. RECENT SOCIAL POSTS (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"SELECT post_id, day, reply_to_agent_post_id, SUBSTR(content, 1, 140) as snippet FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Customer post:", r)

print("\n8. OPEN ENTERPRISE TURNS (AWAITING AGENT REPLY):")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Enterprise turn:", r)

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 31 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}

    if ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.5], ["B", 11.0], ["C", 22.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.0], ["B", 22.0], ["C", 28.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.0], ["B", 19.0], ["C", 24.0]]])
    elif tnum >= 2 and 'price' in offer_data:
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", p], ["B", max(round(p + 4.0, 2), 14.0)], ["C", max(round(p + 8.0, 2), 22.0)]]])
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", round(p * 0.8, 2)], ["B", p], ["C", max(round(p + 6.0, 2), 22.0)]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", round(p * 0.75, 2)], ["B", round(p * 0.9, 2)], ["C", p]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.0], ["B", 19.0], ["C", 25.0]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 11.5], ["B", 14.5], ["C", 23.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.0], ["B", 26.0], ["C", 34.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.0], ["B", 22.0], ["C", 28.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.0], ["B", 16.0], ["C", 22.0]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
print(nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals))

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 4 (8,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4))

print("3. Updating prices (A=20, B=65, C=142) ahead of Week 4 renewal wave...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=20.0, B=65.0, C=142.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) and raising quotas (A=5000, B=10000, C=25000) so enterprise teams never hit daily caps...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=5000, B=10000, C=25000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($2 off for S1 leads -> $18 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 2.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=2000, dev=2500)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2000.0, development=2500.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 850.0,
    'S2': 350.0,
    'S3': 300.0,
    'E1': 150.0,
    'E2': 100.0,
    'E3': 50.0,
}))

print("8. Focusing targeted dev spend on E2/E3 ($7,500/day targeted)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 300.0,
    'S2': 600.0,
    'S3': 600.0,
    'E1': 1000.0,
    'E2': 2500.0,
    'E3': 2500.0,
}))

print("9. Keeping high-ROI targeted ad spend at $6,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1600.0, 'S2': 1400.0, 'S3': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 1000.0, 'S2': 300.0, 'S3': 1200.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 300.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Raised daily usage quotas up to 25,000 units/day for high-throughput enterprise teams, expanded sub-100ms batch processing pipelines, and launched cost-optimized plans for growing businesses!"
))

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 118 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}

    if ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.5], ["B", 11.0], ["C", 22.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.0], ["B", 22.0], ["C", 28.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.0], ["B", 19.0], ["C", 24.0]]])
    elif tnum >= 2 and 'price' in offer_data:
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", p], ["B", max(round(p + 4.0, 2), 14.0)], ["C", max(round(p + 8.0, 2), 22.0)]]])
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", round(p * 0.8, 2)], ["B", p], ["C", max(round(p + 6.0, 2), 22.0)]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", round(p * 0.75, 2)], ["B", round(p * 0.9, 2)], ["C", p]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 120:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.0], ["B", 18.0], ["C", 24.0]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.0], ["B", 16.0], ["C", 22.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 21.0], ["B", 29.0], ["C", 36.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 18.0], ["B", 24.0], ["C", 30.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.0], ["B", 16.0], ["C", 22.0]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Upgrading capacity to Tier 5 (25,000,000 units/day) ahead of 6.5M+ weekday usage...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=5))

print("3. Updating prices (A=21, B=68, C=148) ahead of Week 5 renewal wave...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=21.0, B=68.0, C=148.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) and quotas generous (A=5000, B=10000, C=25000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=5000, B=10000, C=25000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($2.50 off for S1 leads -> $18.50 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 2.5, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=2200, dev=1500)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2200.0, development=1500.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 950.0,
    'S2': 400.0,
    'S3': 350.0,
    'E1': 200.0,
    'E2': 100.0,
    'E3': 100.0,
}))

print("8. Setting disciplined targeted dev spend ($3,500/day targeted)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 200.0,
    'S2': 400.0,
    'S3': 400.0,
    'E1': 500.0,
    'E2': 1000.0,
    'E3': 1000.0,
}))

print("9. Setting high-ROI targeted ad spend at $5,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1400.0, 'S2': 1200.0, 'S3': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 800.0, 'S2': 200.0, 'S3': 1000.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Scaled infrastructure to Tier 5 (25M daily units) for ultra-reliable enterprise performance, and launched ROI-guaranteed deployment playbooks to cut team software costs during economic headwinds!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== ANALYSIS AT DAY {day} ===")

print("\n1. LEDGER BY CATEGORY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT category, COUNT(*) as cnt, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) as total_amount
    FROM ledger
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY total_amount DESC
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

cash = nm.query("SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) as cash FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['cash']
print(f"Total Cash: ${cash:,.2f}")

print("\n2. SERVICE DAY (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT day, total_usage_units, ROUND(p95_ms, 1) as p95_ms, ROUND(error_rate, 4) as err, downtime_minutes, capacity_tier, capacity_units
    FROM service_day
    WHERE day > {day - 7}
    ORDER BY day
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n3. CONVERSION SUMMARY BY GROUP (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.status, s.plan, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_price
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.created_day > {day - 7}
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n4. ACTIVE SUBSCRIBERS BY GROUP & PLAN:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) as active_subs,
           SUM(s.seat_count) as total_seats,
           ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price), 2) as avg_eff_price,
           ROUND(SUM(s.seat_count * s.effective_price), 2) as locked_mrr
    FROM subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan
    ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan
""")
total_mrr = 0.0
for r in res['rows']:
    total_mrr += (r['locked_mrr'] or 0.0)
    print(" ", r)
print(f"Total Locked-In Active MRR: ${total_mrr:,.2f}/month")

print("\n5. UPCOMING 14-DAY BILLING SCHEDULE (BY MOD30):")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT s.billing_day_mod30, COUNT(*) as subs, SUM(s.seat_count) as seats,
           ROUND(SUM(s.seat_count * effective_price), 2) as current_eff_rev
    FROM subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status = 'subscribed'
    GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30
    ORDER BY s.billing_day_mod30
""")
mod_map = {r['billing_day_mod30']: r for r in res['rows']}
for d in range(day + 1, day + 15):
    m = d % 30
    info = mod_map.get(m, {'subs': 0, 'seats': 0, 'current_eff_rev': 0.0})
    print(f"  Day {d:3d} (mod30={m:2d}): subs={info['subs']:4d} | seats={info['seats']:5d} | renewal_rev=${info['current_eff_rev']:10,.2f}")

print("\n6. OPEN ISSUES BY OPEN_DAY & GROUP:")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT group_id, open_day, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM issues
    WHERE status = 'open'
    GROUP BY group_id, open_day
    ORDER BY open_day, group_id
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print(" ", r)

print("\n7. RECENT SOCIAL POSTS (LAST 7 DAYS):")
res = nm.query(f"SELECT post_id, day, reply_to_agent_post_id, SUBSTR(content, 1, 140) as snippet FROM social_media_posts WHERE day > {day - 7} ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 10")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Customer post:", r)

print("\n8. OPEN ENTERPRISE TURNS SUMMARY (AWAITING AGENT REPLY):")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT c.group_id, e.thread_type, e.turn_number, COUNT(*) as cnt,
           SUM((SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1)) as total_seats
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    GROUP BY c.group_id, e.thread_type, e.turn_number
    ORDER BY c.group_id, e.thread_type, e.turn_number
""")
for r in res['rows']:
    print("  Enterprise summary:", r)

./novamind-operation query "SELECT COUNT(*) as by_thread, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as distinct_cust FROM enterprise_turns e WHERE e.closed = 0 AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id) AND e.sender != 'agent'"

arguments.content:
import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 220 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None

    if ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), 1.50)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.78, 2), 8.00)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), 16.00)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.5], ["B", 11.0], ["C", 20.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.0], ["B", 22.0], ["C", 28.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.0], ["B", 19.0], ["C", 24.0]]])
    elif tnum >= 2 and 'price' in offer_data:
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = max(round(p * 0.92, 2), 1.00)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", p_disc], ["B", max(round(p_disc + 4.0, 2), 12.0)], ["C", max(round(p_disc + 8.0, 2), 20.0)]]])
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", max(round(p_disc * 0.8, 2), 1.0)], ["B", p_disc], ["C", max(round(p_disc + 6.0, 2), 20.0)]]])
        else:
            # Counter-offer on Plan C: if p_disc < 12, steer to Plan A/B so compute cost is low
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.72, 2), 1.50)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.86, 2), 5.00)
            pc = max(p_disc, 12.00)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.5], ["B", 18.0], ["C", 25.0]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.5], ["B", 16.5], ["C", 22.5]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 22.0], ["B", 30.0], ["C", 37.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.0], ["B", 25.0], ["C", 32.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.5], ["B", 16.5], ["C", 22.5]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 5 (25,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=5))

print("3. Updating prices (A=22, B=70, C=152) ahead of Week 6 renewal wave...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) and raising quotas (A=10000, B=25000, C=50000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=10000, B=25000, C=50000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($3.00 off for S1 leads -> $19.00 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 3.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=2800, dev=1500)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2800.0, development=1500.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 1400.0,
    'S2': 500.0,
    'S3': 400.0,
    'E1': 300.0,
    'E2': 150.0,
    'E3': 150.0,
}))

print("8. Setting disciplined targeted dev spend ($3,500/day targeted)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 200.0,
    'S2': 400.0,
    'S3': 400.0,
    'E1': 500.0,
    'E2': 1000.0,
    'E3': 1000.0,
}))

print("9. Setting high-ROI targeted ad spend at $5,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1400.0, 'S2': 1200.0, 'S3': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 800.0, 'S2': 200.0, 'S3': 1000.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Expanded daily usage quotas up to 50,000 units and scaled support operations so enterprise and individual teams can run high-volume AI workflows without interruption!"
))

arguments.content:
import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 220 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None

    if ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), 1.50)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.78, 2), 8.00)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), 16.00)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.5], ["B", 11.0], ["C", 20.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.0], ["B", 22.0], ["C", 28.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.0], ["B", 19.0], ["C", 24.0]]])
    elif tnum >= 2 and 'price' in offer_data:
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = max(round(p * 0.92, 2), 1.00)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", p_disc], ["B", max(round(p_disc + 4.0, 2), 12.0)], ["C", max(round(p_disc + 8.0, 2), 20.0)]]])
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", max(round(p_disc * 0.8, 2), 1.0)], ["B", p_disc], ["C", max(round(p_disc + 6.0, 2), 20.0)]]])
        else:
            # Counter-offer on Plan C: if p_disc < 12, steer to Plan A/B so compute cost is low
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.72, 2), 1.50)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.86, 2), 5.00)
            pc = max(p_disc, 12.00)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.5], ["B", 18.0], ["C", 25.0]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.5], ["B", 16.5], ["C", 22.5]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 22.0], ["B", 30.0], ["C", 37.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.0], ["B", 25.0], ["C", 32.0]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.5], ["B", 16.5], ["C", 22.5]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 5 (25,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=5))

print("3. Updating prices (A=22, B=70, C=152) ahead of Week 6 renewal wave...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers stable (A=2, B=3, C=4) and raising quotas (A=10000, B=25000, C=50000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=10000, B=25000, C=50000))

print("5. Setting lead promotion ($3.00 off for S1 leads -> $19.00 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 3.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=2800, dev=1500)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2800.0, development=1500.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend per group...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 1400.0,
    'S2': 500.0,
    'S3': 400.0,
    'E1': 300.0,
    'E2': 150.0,
    'E3': 150.0,
}))

print("8. Setting disciplined targeted dev spend ($3,500/day targeted)...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 200.0,
    'S2': 400.0,
    'S3': 400.0,
    'E1': 500.0,
    'E2': 1000.0,
    'E3': 1000.0,
}))

print("9. Setting high-ROI targeted ad spend at $5,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 1400.0, 'S2': 1200.0, 'S3': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 800.0, 'S2': 200.0, 'S3': 1000.0},
    'social_media': {'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Expanded daily usage quotas up to 50,000 units and scaled support operations so enterprise and individual teams can run high-volume AI workflows without interruption!"
))

arguments.content:
import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 315 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None

    if ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.70, 2), 1.00)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.80, 2), 12.00)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), 16.00)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.5], ["B", 13.0], ["C", 18.0]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 274 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

# Profitable per-seat floors based on unit compute cost on Tier 2 / Tier 3 / Tier 4
FLOORS = {
    'E1': (4.00, 9.50, 17.50),
    'E2': (4.00, 8.00, 13.00),
    'E3': (3.00, 5.00, 7.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (4.00, 9.50, 17.50))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.72, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.82, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.50], ["B", 13.50], ["C", 18.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.00], ["B", 22.00], ["C", 28.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.00], ["B", 19.00], ["C", 24.00]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.50], ["B", 18.50], ["C", 24.00]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.50], ["B", 17.50], ["C", 23.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 21.00], ["B", 29.00], ["C", 36.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 18.00], ["B", 24.00], ["C", 31.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.00], ["B", 18.00], ["C", 24.00]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 5 (25,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=5))

print("3. Keeping prices at A=22, B=70, C=152...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Restoring Plan C to Model Tier 4 (1.00x multiplier) and generous quotas (A=10000, B=25000, C=50000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=10000, B=25000, C=50000))

print("5. Keeping lead promotion ($3.00 off for S1 leads -> $19.00 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 3.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=3000, dev=1500)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=3000.0, development=1500.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend to drain individual ticket backlog and maintain zero enterprise backlog...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 2000.0,
    'S2': 800.0,
    'S3': 600.0,
    'E1': 1000.0,
    'E2': 300.0,
    'E3': 200.0,
}))

print("8. Restoring strong targeted dev spend across all 6 segments to offset Day-72 competitor event...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 1000.0,
    'S2': 600.0,
    'S3': 600.0,
    'E1': 1200.0,
    'E2': 800.0,
    'E3': 600.0,
}))

print("9. Keeping high-ROI targeted ad spend at $2,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 600.0, 'S2': 600.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 300.0, 'S3': 500.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Plan C is now powered by our flagship Tier 4 frontier model with 50,000 daily quota, backed by expanded 24/7 support and R&D investment across all segments!"
))

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 411 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

# Profitable per-seat floors above unit compute cost on Tier 2 ($0.002) / Tier 3 ($0.006) / Tier 4 ($0.012)
FLOORS = {
    'E1': (3.20, 8.20, 15.00),
    'E2': (2.50, 6.00, 10.50),
    'E3': (2.00, 4.00, 6.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (3.20, 8.20, 15.00))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.75, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.00], ["B", 13.00], ["C", 18.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 15.00], ["B", 21.00], ["C", 27.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.00], ["B", 18.00], ["C", 23.00]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0) - slightly sharper given PMI=44.5 contraction
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.50], ["B", 17.50], ["C", 23.00]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 11.50], ["B", 16.50], ["C", 22.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.50], ["B", 27.50], ["C", 34.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.50], ["B", 22.50], ["C", 29.50]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.00], ["B", 17.00], ["C", 22.50]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 5 (25,000,000 units/day) for Week 13...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=5))

print("3. Keeping prices at A=22, B=70, C=152...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers (A=2, B=3, C=4) and raising usage quotas (A=25000, B=100000, C=250000) to eliminate rate-limit friction...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=25000, B=100000, C=250000))

print("5. Keeping lead promotion ($3.00 off for S1 leads -> $19.00 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 3.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=3500, dev=2000)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=3500.0, development=2000.0))

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend to finish draining individual tickets and keep enterprise tickets at zero...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 2500.0,
    'S2': 1000.0,
    'S3': 800.0,
    'E1': 1400.0,
    'E2': 450.0,
    'E3': 250.0,
}))

print("8. Scaling targeted dev spend across all 6 segments...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 1200.0,
    'S2': 800.0,
    'S3': 800.0,
    'E1': 1500.0,
    'E2': 1000.0,
    'E3': 700.0,
}))

print("9. Scaling high-ROI targeted ad spend to $2,500/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 750.0, 'S2': 750.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 400.0, 'S3': 600.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="To support enterprise batch workflows and high-throughput teams, we've expanded daily usage quotas 5x across all plans (up to 250,000 units/day on Plan C) at no additional cost!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 777 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

# Profitable per-seat floors above unit compute cost on Tier 2 ($0.002) / Tier 3 ($0.006) / Tier 4 ($0.012)
FLOORS = {
    'E1': (3.20, 8.20, 15.00),
    'E2': (2.50, 6.00, 10.50),
    'E3': (2.00, 4.00, 6.00),
    'D_E09': (4.00, 10.00, 18.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (3.20, 8.20, 15.00))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.75, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.85, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.00], ["B", 13.00], ["C", 18.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 15.00], ["B", 21.00], ["C", 27.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.00], ["B", 18.00], ["C", 23.00]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.50], ["B", 17.50], ["C", 23.00]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 11.50], ["B", 16.50], ["C", 22.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            if seats < 800:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.50], ["B", 27.50], ["C", 34.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 18.50], ["B", 26.50], ["C", 33.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            if seats < 1200:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.50], ["B", 22.50], ["C", 29.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 15.50], ["B", 21.50], ["C", 28.00]]])
        elif grp == 'D_E09':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 22.00], ["B", 32.00], ["C", 42.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.00], ["B", 18.50], ["C", 24.50]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Upgrading capacity to Tier 6 (80,000,000 units/day) for the 437K-seat enterprise wave...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))

print("3. Keeping prices at A=22, B=70, C=152...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Keeping model tiers (A=2, B=3, C=4) and high usage quotas (A=25000, B=100000, C=250000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=25000, B=100000, C=250000))

print("5. Keeping lead promotion ($3.00 off for S1 leads -> $19.00 Month-1 price)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 3.0, 'S2': 0.0, 'S3': 0.0}
))

print("6. Updating daily spend (ops=4000, dev=2500)...")

print("7. Scaling targeted ops spend across all known segments including D_E09...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 2800.0,
    'S2': 1100.0,
    'S3': 900.0,
    'E1': 1600.0,
    'E2': 600.0,
    'E3': 350.0,
    'D_E09': 150.0,
}))

print("8. Scaling targeted dev spend across all known segments including D_E09...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 1400.0,
    'S2': 900.0,
    'S3': 900.0,
    'E1': 1600.0,
    'E2': 1200.0,
    'E3': 900.0,
    'D_E09': 400.0,
}))

print("9. Scaling high-ROI targeted ad spend to $3,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 800.0, 'S2': 800.0, 'D_E09': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 500.0, 'S3': 700.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="Scaled our global compute cluster 3.2x to 80M daily units for ultra-low P95 latency on enterprise batch workloads, and launched specialized workflows for Real Estate Groups!"
))

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 667 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

# Profitable per-seat floors above unit compute cost on Tier 2 ($0.002) / Tier 3 ($0.006) / Tier 4 ($0.012)
FLOORS = {
    'E1': (3.20, 8.20, 15.00),
    'E2': (2.50, 6.00, 10.50),
    'E3': (2.00, 4.00, 6.00),
    'D_E09': (4.00, 10.00, 18.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (3.20, 8.20, 15.00))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.75, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 6.00, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.78, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.84, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':

print("1. Querying and replying to all 796 open enterprise threads...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

# Profitable per-seat floors above unit compute cost
FLOORS = {
    'E1': (3.20, 8.00, 14.00),
    'E2': (2.50, 6.00, 10.00),
    'E3': (2.00, 4.00, 6.00),
    'D_E09': (4.00, 9.50, 16.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (3.20, 8.00, 14.00))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 5.50, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.75, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 5.50, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.78, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.84, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.00], ["B", 13.00], ["C", 18.00]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.50], ["B", 20.00], ["C", 26.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.50], ["B", 17.50], ["C", 22.50]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 11.50], ["B", 16.50], ["C", 21.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 10.50], ["B", 15.50], ["C", 20.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            if seats < 800:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 18.00], ["B", 25.50], ["C", 32.00]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 17.00], ["B", 24.50], ["C", 30.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            if seats < 1200:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 15.00], ["B", 21.00], ["C", 27.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.00], ["B", 20.00], ["C", 26.00]]])
        elif grp == 'D_E09':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 19.00], ["B", 26.00], ["C", 34.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.00], ["B", 17.50], ["C", 23.00]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Keeping capacity at Tier 6 (80,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))

print("3. Keeping prices at A=22, B=70, C=152...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("4. Setting model tiers (A=2, B=3, C=3) for Week 16 to cut compute spend by 50% while Plan C quality remains 0.98-1.01, and quotas (A=10000, B=25000, C=50000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=3))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=10000, B=25000, C=50000))

print("5. Keeping lead promotion (S1=$4.50, S2=$3.00, S3=$3.00)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 4.5, 'S2': 3.0, 'S3': 3.0}
))

print("6. Disciplined daily spend (ops=2000, dev=1000) to maximize cash accumulation during Week 16...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=2000.0, development=1000.0))

print("7. Targeted ops spend across all known segments...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 1500.0,
    'S2': 600.0,
    'S3': 500.0,
    'E1': 1200.0,
    'E2': 500.0,
    'E3': 300.0,
    'D_E09': 100.0,
}))

print("8. Targeted dev spend across all 7 segments...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 500.0,
    'S2': 300.0,
    'S3': 300.0,
    'E1': 600.0,
    'E2': 600.0,
    'E3': 400.0,
    'D_E09': 500.0,
}))

print("9. High-efficiency targeted ad spend at $1,000/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 300.0, 'S2': 300.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 200.0, 'S3': 200.0},
}))

print("10. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="NovaMind Assistant now serves over 257,000 enterprise seats and 74,000 individual creators with 99.6% uptime and sub-185ms P95 latency on our 80M-unit infrastructure!"
))

import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all open enterprise threads at Day 112...")
rows = nm.query("""
SELECT et.thread_id, et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.thread_type, et.turn_number, et.sender, et.seat_count,
       s.plan as current_plan, s.effective_price as current_price
FROM enterprise_turns et
JOIN (
    SELECT thread_id, MAX(turn_number) as max_turn
    FROM enterprise_turns
    WHERE closed = 0
    GROUP BY thread_id
) latest ON et.thread_id = latest.thread_id AND et.turn_number = latest.max_turn
JOIN customers c ON et.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON et.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
WHERE et.sender != 'agent'
""")['rows']

deals = []
for r in rows:
    tid = r['thread_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    turn = r['turn_number']
    cur_plan = r['current_plan']
    cur_price = r['current_price'] or 20.0

    if ttype == 'churn_prevention':
        if cur_plan == 'C':
            if grp == 'E1':
                p_c = round(max(12.0, cur_price * 0.80), 2)
                p_b = round(max(8.5, cur_price * 0.65), 2)
                p_a = round(max(6.0, cur_price * 0.50), 2)
            else:
                p_c = round(max(17.5, cur_price * 0.80), 2)
                p_b = round(max(13.0, cur_price * 0.65), 2)
                p_a = round(max(9.5, cur_price * 0.50), 2)
        else:
            # Customer is on Plan A or Plan B; give them an irresistible upgrade to Plan C (Tier 4)!
            if grp == 'E1':
                p_c = round(max(12.5, cur_price * 0.90), 2)
                p_b = round(max(8.5, cur_price * 0.72), 2)
                p_a = round(max(6.0, cur_price * 0.55), 2)
            else:
                p_c = round(max(18.0, cur_price * 0.90), 2)
                p_b = round(max(13.0, cur_price * 0.72), 2)
                p_a = round(max(9.5, cur_price * 0.55), 2)
        offers = [
            {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": p_a, "contract_months": 1},
            {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": p_b, "contract_months": 1},
            {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": p_c, "contract_months": 1},
        ]
    else:
        if grp == 'E1':
            if turn == 0:
                offers = [
                    {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": 11.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": 14.5, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": 18.5, "contract_months": 1},
                ]
            elif turn <= 2:
                offers = [
                    {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": 10.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": 13.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": 16.5, "contract_months": 1},
                ]
            else:
                offers = [
                    {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": 8.5, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": 11.5, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": 15.0, "contract_months": 1},
                ]
        elif grp in ('E2', 'E3'):
            if turn == 0:
                offers = [
                    {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": 18.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": 23.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": 28.5, "contract_months": 1},
                ]
            elif turn <= 2:
                offers = [
                    {"plan": "A", "price_per_seat": 15.5, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "B", "price_per_seat": 20.0, "contract_months": 1},
                    {"plan": "C", "price_per_seat": 25.0, "contract_months": 1},
                ]

import json
import novamind_api as nm

print("1. Querying and replying to all 423 open enterprise threads at Day 112...")
res = nm.query("""
    SELECT e.message_id, e.thread_id, e.customer_id, c.group_id,
           (SELECT e0.seat_count FROM enterprise_turns e0 WHERE e0.thread_id = e.thread_id AND e0.turn_number = 0 LIMIT 1) as seats,
           e.thread_type, e.turn_number, e.sender, e.day, e.offer_json, e.message_text,
           s.plan as cur_plan, s.effective_price as cur_price
    FROM enterprise_turns e
    JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id AND s.status = 'subscribed'
    WHERE e.closed = 0
      AND e.message_id = (SELECT MAX(e2.message_id) FROM enterprise_turns e2 WHERE e2.thread_id = e.thread_id)
      AND e.sender != 'agent'
    ORDER BY e.day ASC, e.message_id ASC
""")

FLOORS = {
    'E1': (3.20, 7.50, 11.50),
    'E2': (2.50, 6.00, 10.00),
    'E3': (2.00, 4.00, 6.00),
    'D_E09': (4.00, 9.50, 16.00),
}

deals = []
for r in res['rows']:
    cid = r['customer_id']
    grp = r['group_id']
    seats = r['seats'] or 100
    ttype = r['thread_type']
    tnum = r['turn_number']
    msg = r['message_text'] or ''
    offer_data = json.loads(r['offer_json']) if r['offer_json'] else {}
    cur_plan = r['cur_plan']
    cur_price = float(r['cur_price']) if r['cur_price'] is not None else None
    min_a, min_b, min_c = FLOORS.get(grp, (3.20, 7.50, 11.50))

    if isinstance(offer_data, dict) and 'price' in offer_data:
        # Customer counter-offer (on new_lead, churn_prevention, or renegotiation)
        p = float(offer_data['price'])
        p_disc = round(p * 0.90, 2)
        if 'Plan A' in msg:
            pa = max(p_disc, min_a)
            pb = max(round(pa + 4.50, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 5.00, 2), min_c)
        elif 'Plan B' in msg:
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.75, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(p_disc, min_b)
            pc = max(round(pb + 5.00, 2), min_c)
        else:
            # Plan C or unspecified
            pa = max(round(p_disc * 0.65, 2), min_a)
            pb = max(round(p_disc * 0.80, 2), min_b)
            pc = max(p_disc, min_c)
        deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
    elif ttype in ('churn_prevention', 'renegotiation'):
        if cur_price is not None:
            if cur_plan == 'C':
                pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.55, 2), min_a)
                pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.70, 2), min_b)
                pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.82, 2), min_c)
            else:
                # On Plan A or B: make upgrading to Plan C (Tier 4) super attractive!
                pa = max(round(cur_price * 0.60, 2), min_a)
                pb = max(round(cur_price * 0.75, 2), min_b)
                pc = max(round(cur_price * 0.90, 2), min_c)
            deals.append([cid, [["A", pa], ["B", pb], ["C", pc]]])
        elif grp == 'E1':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 8.00], ["B", 12.50], ["C", 16.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.00], ["B", 19.50], ["C", 25.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.00], ["B", 17.00], ["C", 22.00]]])
    else:
        # New lead (turn_number == 0)
        if grp == 'E1':
            if seats < 150:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 11.00], ["B", 15.50], ["C", 19.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 10.00], ["B", 14.50], ["C", 18.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E2':
            if seats < 800:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 17.50], ["B", 24.00], ["C", 30.00]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 16.50], ["B", 23.00], ["C", 28.50]]])
        elif grp == 'E3':
            if seats < 1200:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 14.50], ["B", 20.50], ["C", 26.50]]])
            else:
                deals.append([cid, [["A", 13.50], ["B", 19.50], ["C", 25.00]]])
        elif grp == 'D_E09':
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 18.00], ["B", 25.00], ["C", 32.00]]])
        else:
            deals.append([cid, [["A", 12.00], ["B", 17.00], ["C", 22.00]]])

print(f"Sending {len(deals)} enterprise deals...")
out = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
print(f"Sent {len(out.get('results', []))} deals, all success={all(x.get('success') for x in out.get('results', []))}")

print("2. Starting R&D Tier 2 Project (Evaluation & Testing Pipeline, $333,333, mean +0.07 quality boost in ~17 days)...")
print(nm.research.start_research_project(tier=2))

print("3. Keeping capacity at Tier 6 (80,000,000 units/day)...")
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))

print("4. Keeping prices at A=22, B=70, C=152...")
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=22.0, B=70.0, C=152.0))

print("5. Restoring model tiers (A=2, B=3, C=4) and high quotas (A=25000, B=100000, C=250000)...")
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=25000, B=100000, C=250000))

print("6. Keeping lead promotion (S1=$4.50, S2=$3.00, S3=$3.00)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(
    global_promotion=0.0,
    by_group={'S1': 4.5, 'S2': 3.0, 'S3': 3.0}
))

print("7. Scaling daily spend (ops=4000, dev=5000)...")
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=4000.0, development=5000.0))

print("8. Scaling targeted ops spend across all known segments...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group={
    'S1': 3000.0,
    'S2': 1500.0,
    'S3': 1200.0,
    'E1': 2000.0,
    'E2': 1200.0,
    'E3': 800.0,
    'D_E09': 300.0,
}))

print("9. Scaling targeted dev spend across all 7 segments to counter competitor quality shocks...")
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={
    'S1': 1500.0,
    'S2': 1500.0,
    'S3': 1500.0,
    'E1': 2000.0,
    'E2': 2500.0,
    'E3': 2500.0,
    'D_E09': 2500.0,
}))

print("10. Setting targeted ad spend at $1,500/day...")
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S1': 400.0, 'S2': 400.0, 'D_E09': 200.0},
    'referral_program': {'S1': 250.0, 'S3': 250.0},
}))

print("11. Posting social media update...")
print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(
    content="We've upgraded Plan C back to our flagship Tier 4 reasoning engine, expanded daily rate limits 5x to 250,000 units/day, and launched our Evaluation & Testing Pipeline R&D initiative!"
))
